Elliot (CS): Mika from NexxisPay asked for APAC pin + EU backup for a partner webinar next Wed. Needs ap-southeast-1 primary, eu-west-1 fallback, allowlist 203.0.113.11/32 & 198.51.100.33/32, CORS https://partners.nexxispay.com, and a temporary qps increase to 450 for 3h (2026-04-22 09:00-12:00 SGT). They also want a scoped demo key limited to model=v2-lite, retention=0, and an automatic rollback 30m after window end. Can infra/security enable? @Ravi @June @Hana
Mika (NexxisPay): Confirming. We'll run two concurrent sessions (~50 attendees) with streaming. Can the demo key be single-use per origin and expire 1h after the window? Also sales flagged this as "renewal at risk"  big demo for execs.
Ravi (Eng Infra): We can pin tenant=nexxispay and create a primary route in ap-southeast-1 with eu-west-1 failover. For 450 qps + streaming, recommend reserving 4x g4dn-equivalents and autoscale min=4 max=6. We'll prepare staging ACL now. Need signed demo AUP before prod ACL push.
June (SRE): Reserving 4 nodes; autoscale policy applied (min=4 max=6, scale trigger p95>650ms). I'll set automated rollback: after window ends, reduce capacity to baseline over 30m unless CS flags extend. Alerts set for cpu>75%, p95>700ms, error-rate>0.5%. ops-bot will emit route events.
Hana (Security): Token constraints: allowed_ips=["203.0.113.11/32","198.51.100.33/32"], allowed_origins=["https://partners.nexxispay.com"], model=v2-lite, retention=0, single_use=true, expires=2026-04-22T13:00:00Z. Require signed Demo Agreement + security addendum. We'll also mask request bodies and disable debug logs.
Elliot (CS): I'll send the AUP + addendum now and request signature by EOD tomorrow to get token out 24h before demo. Sales will be on standby for renewal follow-up after demo.
ops-bot: Route reservation created: route-nexxispay-ap-southeast-1 queued at 6310012349 by June (SRE)
Mika (NexxisPay): We'll sign today. One more ask: can you enable a short canary route for first 15 minutes to test at 50% capacity before we go full 450qps?
June (SRE): Yes  canary policy ok: first15m at 225 qps, then ramp to 450qps over 5m. I'll attach the canary config and monitor.
Ravi (Eng Infra): Staging proxy config (apply to prod after sign-off):
```json
{"tenant":"nexxispay","primary_region":"ap-southeast-1","fallback_region":"eu-west-1","allowlist":["203.0.113.11/32","198.51.100.33/32"],"cors":["https://partners.nexxispay.com"],"qps_limit":450,"canary":{"duration_min":15,"initial_qps":225,"ramp_to":450},"token_policy":{"model":"v2-lite","retention":0,"single_use":true,"expires":"2026-04-22T13:00:00Z"}}
```
Elliot (CS): Thanks team. Once Mika uploads signed AUP I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over the scoped demo key. Mika, please upload and ping here when done.
Mika (NexxisPay): Uploading now. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll report back after the webinar for renewal conversation.
